name: [UPD] Escape Lava for Fish!
desc:
🔥 Welcome to Escape Lava For Fish! 🔥

🏃 Run fast and collect Fish!
🌋 Dodge the rising Lava when it strikes!
⚡ Stay alive to earn more Fish and cash!

🐟 Upgrade your Fish to boost income
💸 Earn money even while offline!
🏗️ Upgrade your base to unlock more slots and place extra Fish

👍 Like the game & join the group for FREE Cash!
